text: THE DBIM IMPORTANT LINKS CARRY THE DEPARTMENT'S PRIORITY DESTINATIONS AS WELL AS ITS DIVISIONS. DBIM 3.0 §7.3 x calls this section "the most accessed or priority contents/portals … for quick navigation", and the benchmark, meity.gov.in, fills it with five. The list now holds nineteen rows in three groups: the four actions a citizen may have arrived for (the Nasha Mukt Bharat e-pledge, the Mitr sign-up, the de-addiction centre finder, the SAMAVESH gateway), then five priority destinations (Dashboard — Ministry › Our Performance, Tenders, Public Grievance Redressal Mechanism, the Social Audit MIS Portal, What's New), then the Department's ten divisions. The home section is unchanged and still a window on the same list — its first four rows and its View more, which opens the Important Links page in full, where all nineteen are searchable and paged at ten. One record feeds both, so the home page and the page behind it cannot disagree. Which destinations are in fact most accessed is to be confirmed by the Department; no usage figures were available, so the choice follows the benchmark's categories.
